title: Social Lock Operating Matrix bridge handoff
objective: Ingest, verify, extend, and operationalise the portfolio social/domain lock matrix for public and commercial brands only.
required_outputs: Create or update Supabase tables for brands, social accounts, platforms, evidence, assets, automation readiness, comments, and verification history.
Ingest attached workbook/CSV package when available to bridge runtime.
Normalise matrix into row-per-brand and row-per-platform records.
Support adding more brands/domains without schema changes.
Support adding more social/platform columns via platform catalog rather than hardcoded workbook-only columns.
Create evidence rows for every verified account, handle, domain, asset, and automation state.
Classify unverified entries as PARTIAL or PRETEND, never REAL.
Return a receipt with commit/file paths, validation results, table names, row counts, and any blockers.

recommended_schema.ops.social_platform_catalog: extensible platform definitions and required fields
recommended_schema.ops.social_account_lock: brand-platform account status, handle, URL, admin, MFA, vault, BM, pixel, CRM, lead capture, automation
recommended_schema.ops.social_content_queue: launch posts, reels, CTAs, approval state and posting schedule
recommended_schema.ops.brand_asset_register: logos, bios, colours, link-in-bio, media, templates

bridge_notes: Workbook, CSV, platform catalog, JSON payload, SQL and normaliser package were prepared in the ChatGPT sandbox. This PEN payload logs the execution request and required runtime receipt. Bridge must fetch/receive artifacts, persist a copy, run validation, and return receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Internal systems excluded from commercial social matrix.
Matrix remains extensible for new brands and new platforms.
No unverified social account is marked REAL.
Receipt includes evidence classification and next blockers.
